answer_2.quote: We utilize F1, Ign F1, precision, and recall as the primary metrics, where the Ign F1 score excludes triplets shared between the training and test sets to avoid data leakage. We also compute F1 scores for frequent classes (the top 10 most common relation types) and long-tail classes (all other relation types), denoted as Freq_F1 and LT_F1, respectively.
